_comment: MISSION GRAPHS — authored BEFORE rooms, validated by tools/verify-graphs.mjs
(playbook §4/§11). One entry per region; regions are added here as their
reward|boss|connector|safe. beat: ki|sho|ten|ketsu for teaching rooms.
the wolf IS the dungeon item, granted at the end, with the region's
scorched/cracked/bramble promise-gates as its >=3 dormant affordances,
recontextualizing on the walk back. Each region ALSO carries a non-wolf
MID-REGION DISCOVERY as the second item beat. Density scales by region:
L1-L3 kid-weighted (3 required puzzles), L4-L7 full (5-6). Blocks snap
to the grid; the player never does.

ember_hollow.item_note: A carried socket-stone found mid-region (lc1). Carrying it disables the special (the Wild Arms trade). AS SHIPPED (2026-08-29): one socket only, at lg3 — a side-quest bonus (spawns shards), not a gate; lc1 is off SPINE so nothing about clearing the region depends on it. The 3-socket design below (treasure/shortcut/boss-door) is the original intent, not yet built — the boss door at lg4/le is already correctly gated by the region's own bossGate/fire_wolf-grant logic, and retrofitting a required emberstone spend onto it risks that tested path for a want, not a need. Revisit as its own pass if the extra sockets earn their keep.
known_gaps: push_block has ki(lg1)+sho(lb)+ten(lb2) but no ketsu — accepted for now under L1's kid-weighted density (3 required puzzles, not the full 4-beat arc); tools/known-fail.txt documents the resulting tools/verify-graphs.mjs failure.

geyser_timing was listed as an element from the start but no geyser hazard was ever built (world.geysers exists, nothing populates it) — dropped from the elements list above; lb2's ten beat ships as a routing twist instead (see its node note).

nodes.note: SHIPPED: one block, one plate, no enemies, cannot fail. The plate lifts BOTH the bars on a wall vault (chest: shield_a) and the bars on the north door — so the first push in the game teaches 'a plate opens things' with a prize and a road on the same clang. The way back south is never barred.

SHIPPED: two blocks, two plates (l1_lb_sho_p1/p2). BOTH must be down — one plate is half an answer and opens nothing, which is the develop step. Payout: an east-wall vault (chest: heart piece) and the north door to lg2, i.e. the road to the Kiln. The other three doors stay open throughout, so the room is somewhere to think, never a cell.

SHIPPED, revised: geyser timing was never a real hazard in this build (world.geysers exists but nothing ever populates it) — building one from scratch for a single optional room was too much new surface for the reward. Shipped twist instead: a spur wall means the straight push doesn't reach the plate, so the block must be routed the long way round its open end (routing, not timing). Payout: a corner vault (chest: axe_ember, the region's best weapon) — the hardest push in Ember guards the best thing in it. Gates treasure only, never the road: lb2 is a dead end, so a child who cannot route the block loses a prize, not their game. Distinct from the OTHER chest here, still correctly dormant behind the fire_slam scorched gate.
the Causeway: geysers telegraph a full cycle before they can hurt (L9), moths overhead
mini-encounter, then THE EMBERSTONE. Pip teaches carry: held overhead, special disabled while borne
socket: spending the stone here opens the shortcut back to la (closes the cycle). Refundable.

REVISED, matches what actually shipped (pre-dates this graph): no push_block content — ld/ld1 is the region's OWN ki->sho->ten arc for fire_slam itself (safe teach brazier, timed 3-brazier Gutter Run, then ld1's dark-wolf-only brazier-order twist), validated separately by design/WORLD-DESIGN.md + js/regions.js's validateRegions() (against its own stale ka/kb/r3 ids — a second gap, out of scope here). Not this graph's business: rebuilding it around a lava-channel block puzzle would mean tearing out tested, shipped content to satisfy a schema instead of the other way round.
POST-BOSS: the four-brazier order room (needs fire_slam — dormant #3). Dark; dark_sight reads the order rings.
the Shadowgrip -> FIRE WOLF. Walk-back recontext: scorched gates in la, lb2 and the firePromise gates burn open (>=3 dormant affordances)

edges.note: the shortcut socket — optional, closes the cycle
the boss-door socket — the required spend
